npcs.biography: Ask around town for a blacksmith and someone will point you to Dara at Ironbloom Forge. At 86, this Dwarf has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to forge a gate hinge that outlasts gossip. What keeps them careful is watch steel leaking to alleys.
